dataset.description: Textual compilation of insights gained while consulting with system operators and other specialists involved in modelling and resilience evaluation of energy supply systems in the Baltic states within Methods and Tools for Control of Resilience of Integrated Energy Systems (1.1.1.9/LZP/1/24/066). Metadata will include, file format, dates of consultations, date of the latest document version. Insights gained will be used for refinement of the initial IntEneRes framework and/or used mathematical formulations and/or definition of the case study scenarios.

distribution.title: The compiled insights will be used for refinement of the initial IntEneRes framework and/or used mathematical formulations and/or definition of the case study scenarios.

dataset.title: Insights of the consultations with experts involved in modelling and resilience evaluation of energy supply systems in the Baltic states

dmp.description: This Data Management Plan outlines the principles for collecting, processing, storing, and sharing of data collected and generated during the IntEneRes project. The plan will detail these facets both for collected input data and generated results. The project is implemented within the Activity 1.1.1.9 "Post-doctoral Research" of the Specific Objective 1.1.1 "Strengthening research and innovative capacities and introduction of advanced technologies in the common R&D system" of the European Union's Cohesion Policy Programme for 2021-2027 and co-funded by the European Union.
